title: Large time difference DanaRS + Unihertz Jelly Star
body:
Hi,
I keep getting the message that there is a large time difference between pump and smartphone, but every time I check the time, pump and smartphone have the same time, not even one minute difference.
What I tried so far:
• automatic timezone --> off
• automatic time -->off
• Pump clear history
• unpair and pair pump
• Phone power off and on a few times a day
• Reset smartphone and installed new build AAPS
• Change language settings in English

I had this alarm with two different Dana RS pumps (6yrs old and 2 yrs old) and two different smartphones (Unihertz Jelly Star + Unihertz Jelly 2)

Phone is always in airplane mode, only online 1-2x per week for data upload.
I‘ve attached pictures and the last log, alarm occured at : 10:31:09.536

Thanks.
Christina
